//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the toast component — scoped to the SINGLE pa-toast block (one toast ITEM), NOT the sibling pa-toast-container (the positioned stack is a separate block/concern, grepped out of this contract). Goldens are the canonical snippets/toasts.html shape + _toasts.scss. A toast is alert-shaped: severity variant (NO secondary/light/dark — toast has only primary/success/danger/warning/info), an optional theme-colour slot (1..9), a `filled` full-colour style that swaps the variant class to pa-toast--filled-*, a leading icon chip, a title + message content column, a trailing close button, and (svelte-only; see wrapper notes) an actions row + a JS-animated progress bar. See ../README.md and alert.json/badge.json for the model.

propsVocabulary.variant: severity variant (primary|success|danger|warning|info) — NO secondary/light/dark, unlike alert/badge
propsVocabulary.themeColor: 1..9 theme colour slot (emits pa-toast--color-N bordered, or pa-toast--filled-color-N when filled); overrides named variant
propsVocabulary.filled: boolean — full-colour background style; swaps the variant class to pa-toast--filled-{variant} (or pa-toast--filled-color-N with themeColor)
propsVocabulary.show: boolean — SSR visibility/enter state; emits pa-toast--show (both wrappers default to visible/true so every toast carries it)
propsVocabulary.icon: leading icon glyph rendered inside pa-toast__icon (the snippet always leads with an icon chip)
propsVocabulary.title: title text rendered as .pa-toast__title
propsVocabulary.actions: action-button row rendered as .pa-toast__actions INSIDE .pa-toast__content, under a separator (Undo/Retry/etc.)
propsVocabulary.close: trailing dismiss button (.pa-toast__close). svelte renders it unconditionally; keen renders it only when an on_close event is wired — scenarios pass it so both emit the close affordance.

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the core snippet shape. Every toast leads with a .pa-toast__icon chip (snippet always has one; keen auto-derives the glyph from the variant, svelte renders the icon slot — scenarios always pass an explicit icon so both emit the chip with the same content), a .pa-toast__content column holding .pa-toast__title + .pa-toast__message (+ optional .pa-toast__actions), and a trailing .pa-toast__close <button> whose glyph is the masked .pa-icon--x primitive. The close carries aria-label="Close" (both wrappers resolve their close-label i18n key to "Close" in English) and — matching the snippet — NO type="button" and NO role on the toast root (the toast snippet, unlike the alert snippet, blesses neither; see honestNotes). Slot content (icon/title/message/actions) is a plain text token so the diff checks structural nesting, not rich content — real icon usage is <span class=pa-icon>. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.
honestNotes: (1) type="button" on the close: the toast snippet's close button carries NO type (unlike the alert snippet), and NEITHER wrapper emits one, so the golden omits it — consistent across oracle + both wrappers (no bug to fix here, unlike alert which caught keen's missing type). (2) role on the toast root: the snippet sets no role (the toast-service JS owns live-region semantics at the container level), and neither wrapper emits one — golden omits it. (3) pa-toast__progress is JS-animated: keen's toast/1 does NOT server-render it (its PureAdminToast hook builds + animates it at runtime), and svelte emits only a static initial frame with a dynamic inline transition — so it sits in cssStateElements, out of the shared SSR compare surface. (4) pa-toast--hide is a pure JS exit-state class neither wrapper SSR-emits → cssStateClasses.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (NOT components.json — misses the SCSS @for/@each color-1..9 + filled loops). `produces` is a class template; capability.mjs expands it and cross-checks against main.css AND each wrapper map + scenarios. `filled` reuses the {variant}+appliesToVariants expansion (pa-toast--filled-{variant}); themeColor reuses outlineProduces as its filled-color-{value} channel. `produces: null` = structural/native.

variant.note: Toast has NO secondary/light/dark variants (alert/badge do) — only the 5 severity variants.

themeColor.note: overrides named variant. outlineProduces is the filled channel (themeColor + filled → pa-toast--filled-color-{n}); the slot is named `outlineProduces` only because capability.mjs expands it over `options`.

filled.note: Full-colour style — swaps the variant class rather than adding a modifier. With themeColor it routes through themeColor.outlineProduces (pa-toast--filled-color-{n}) instead.

show.note: SSR enter/visible state. Both wrappers default to visible (svelte show / keen is_visible both default true) so every golden carries pa-toast--show; the sibling exit-state pa-toast--hide is JS-only (cssStateClasses).

icon.note: Leading chip. svelte renders the chip only when the icon slot is present; keen renders the chip unconditionally and auto-derives the glyph from the variant when no icon slot is given. Scenarios always pass an explicit icon token so both emit an identical chip.

actions.note: Button row INSIDE pa-toast__content, after the message. keen's toast/1 gained an :actions slot to match the snippet (see wrapper-bug note).

close.note: Dismiss button. svelte renders it unconditionally; keen renders it only when on_close is wired. Scenarios always pass a close token so keen emits it too. The passed value is the dismiss event name for keen (phx-click, normalized away) and is ignored by svelte's onclose callback under SSR.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: pa-toast--* block modifiers toggled by pa-*.js / toast-service at runtime (never hand-authored as a prop). The axis-1 block-modifier reverse check counts these as claimed.
cssStateClasses.pa-toast--hide: Exit-state class — toast-service adds it on dismiss (opacity 0 + off-axis transform) just before removal. Neither wrapper SSR-emits it.

cssStateElements.//: pa-toast__* elements built/animated by JS at runtime, outside the shared SSR compare surface.
cssStateElements.pa-toast__progress: Auto-dismiss progress bar. keen's toast/1 does NOT server-render it — its PureAdminToast JS hook builds + animates it from push_toast; svelte emits only a static initial frame carrying a dynamic inline `transition: width {duration}ms linear`. Data-driven/animation element, not part of the canonical shared golden.
